title: Marked Attribute Bias in Natural Language Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models to measure 'marked attribute bias' by testing whether neutral terms like 'person' disproportionately imply default male attributes versus marked female attributes. The evaluation uses premise-hypothesis pairs containing explicit gender words, implicit gender carriers (names), and latent gender carriers (stereotypical occupations). It also measures intrinsic embedding biases using Multi-dimensional Information-weighted Direct Bias (MIDB), Direct Bias, Clustering, Recoverability, GIPE, and SemBias.
